awf: render agentic-workflow tooling into a project from a committed .awf config tree

help:
  usage:
    awf <command> [flags]
  commands:
    commands:
      init | Scaffold .awf/ and render the workflow-core set
    commands:
      render | Re-render after a template or config change
    commands:
      check | Verify the repository and staged universes
    check:
      commands:
        commit-policy | Verify exact commit provenance for explicit targets
      commands:
        repo | Verify repository properties
      repo:
        drift | Report stale or hand-edited rendered output
        state | Report current-state authority findings
        prose | Scan tracked text files for typographic punctuation, blocking
        memory | Scan staged decision records for working-memory citations, blocking
      commands:
        staged | Verify staged transition properties
      staged:
        state | Report staged current-state transition findings
        drift | Compare staged config with staged rendered output
        commit | Validate one commit message and stale-ADR merge authorization, blocking
    commands:
      read | Read an executable projection from a parsed artifact
    read:
      commands:
        plan | Read one exact plan phase or task projection
    commands:
      audit | Report workflow-conformance findings over a commit range (advisory)
    commands:
      effort | Manage slugged repository-local efforts
    effort:
      commands:
        new | Create an effort with a managed worktree by default
      commands:
        list | List efforts by slug
      commands:
        show | Show one effort
      commands:
        finish | Finish and delete one effort
      commands:
        worktree | Add or remove a managed worktree
      commands:
        integrate | Integrate a managed worktree
      commands:
        memory | Update bounded effort memory metadata
      memory:
        update | Update memory phase or next action
      commands:
        activity | Mutate advisory Pi session activity
      activity:
        attach | Attach or take over an advisory activity claim
        heartbeat | Heartbeat an owned advisory activity claim
        detach | Detach an owned advisory activity claim
    commands:
      adr | ADR lifecycle operations
    adr:
      commands:
        number | Number pending ADRs at integration
    commands:
      list | Show targets and their per-project state (all kinds, or one)
    commands:
      config | Describe config keys and vars (live state inside a project)
    commands:
      context | Orient by request with compact current-state impact reports
    commands:
      topic | Query current claims, history, references, and applicability
    commands:
      new | Scaffold a new artifact: kind ∈ {adr, plan, topic, skill, agent, doc}
    new:
      commands:
        adr | Scaffold a new ADR
      commands:
        plan | Scaffold a new plan
      commands:
        topic | Scaffold paired current-state topic inputs
      commands:
        skill | Scaffold a project-local skill
      commands:
        agent | Scaffold a project-local agent
      commands:
        doc | Scaffold a project-local doc
    commands:
      enable | Enable an artifact: kind ∈ {skill, agent, doc, domain, target, bootstrap, hooks, runner}
    commands:
      disable | Disable an artifact: kind ∈ {skill, agent, doc, domain, target, bootstrap, hooks, runner}
    commands:
      upgrade | Migrate the .awf/ config tree or consume a current-state attestation
    commands:
      uninstall | Remove awf's generated files (keeps .awf/)
    commands:
      changelog | Print the embedded changelog, or one version/range of it
    commands:
      version | Print the awf version
  related commands:
    awf <command> --help
